Name: ZG's Edwin portrait (dead boy detectives)
Author: ZZingaeS2
Description:
This portrait is Edwin from Dead Boy detectives.
I tried to draw it as close to the basic portrait as possible, but there are also parts with adaptations.
I don't have a hell portrait because I haven't figured out exactly what it's for yet. It's possible to add it when I find out later, but it's still undecided.

How to install

[list]
[*]If you don't already have them, download the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url]﻿ mod 
[*]Download this mod.
[*]Mods/Portraiture/Portraits and create a new folder.
[*]Put the portraits from this mod into the new folder.
[/list]Can use both Portraiture and PortraiturePlus . I usually use Portraiture, and I can't explain this because I don't use Portraitureplus (Because I don't know how to it)

You don't need to rename this file. Just put it in the name I made and it works.
